__comment: Merchant Catalog — items that visiting merchant caravans can potentially sell to the colony.
STATUS: STUB — this file is incomplete. Only items referenced in 51_visitors.md
are defined here. A full catalog requires a dedicated design session to establish:
- The complete list of surface-world goods (spices, fabrics, tools, exotic seeds, etc.)
- Which caravan types carry which item categories
- Pricing tiers and rarity weights
- Any items that are exclusive to high trade_reputation unlocks
SCHEMA (per catalog entry):
display_name      — name shown in trade counter inspect panel and notifications
description       — one-sentence flavour text
base_sell_price   — base gold coins the merchant charges per unit
actual price fluctuates ±20% based on caravan type and
recent purchase history (demand modifier)
caravan_types     — array of caravan type keys that may carry this item.
Empty array means no caravan carries it (reserved/future).
stock_range       — [min, max] units a caravan of a matching type may carry.
Actual stock is randomised within this range per visit.
min_reputation    — minimum trade_reputation required for this item to appear.
0 = always available from first visit.
material_tags     — tags used by stockpile zone filters when goods are deposited
into colony storage after purchase.
CARAVAN TYPES (defined in 51_visitors.md):
'small_merchant'    — Spring; general goods, small stock
'travelling_fair'   — Summer (70% chance); luxury and exotic focus
'trade_expedition'  — Autumn; bulk goods, wide catalog
'emergency_supply'  — Winter conditional; food and basics only

catalog.__comment_food: Basic surface food — carried by most caravans as common stock

base:merchant:surface_food.description: Dried fruits, hard cheese, and travel bread from the lowland farms.

catalog.__comment_exotic: Rare and exotic goods — luxury caravans and trade expeditions only

base:merchant:exotic_spice.description: Fragrant dried spices from distant lowland markets. Dwarves don't cook with them, but they trade well.

catalog.__comment_seeds: Rare seeds — plants not native to the mountain that must be imported

base:merchant:rare_seed.description: A seed packet of unknown lowland origin. Plant it and see what grows.
